note: Private family campground at Hell bordering Pinckney Recreation Area state land, with Hell Creek running through it. A general campground, not horse-only: the on-site Hell Creek Equestrian Center adds a 'Horse Hotel' and guided rides. 60 electric sites and 40 primitive; about 16 sites are seasonal on the operator's map. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (Wix), phone 734-878-3632 matches. Added the rate card: $25 electric-only base to $35 concrete-pad W&E ($20 primitive), dated by its 2025-03-19 upload; water hookups, 100 sites, showers/dump/wifi. A general campground with an equestrian side (Horse Hotel), not horse-only. Long-stay: weekly/monthly/seasonal sold, but nightly rates are posted and the site map shows ~16 seasonal of ~99 numbered sites, so not seasonal in character. Gate: $25 base, under US$50 (no gateway within 40 km; Detroit 76 km; family has not stayed). Not stated by the operator: amperage (30, derived, left), 60-ft max length (derived, left), season Apr 1-Oct 31 (derived, left; winter storage runs Nov 1 - Apr 1), how to reserve, sewer, military discount (Good Sam directory, left). Note cleaned of hookup, length, season, price and booking text.
